at_sure_certain: Certain: worked out from the records
at_sure_likely: Likely: some records are still on their way
at_not_shown: Not shown: the figure could not be worked out exactly.
at_not_adviser: I explain in general terms. I am not a lawyer, accountant or adviser; I can put you in touch with one.
at_unconfirmed: This country rule is still waiting for confirmation.
at_w_price_below_cost: This price is below what it cost you ({cost}).
at_w_duplicate_invoice: This invoice looks like a copy of one you already sent.
at_w_date_in_past: This date is in the past.
at_w_cash_mismatch: The cash counted does not match what the till expects.
at_w_stock_low: This product is below its reorder level.
at_sample: This changes {n} items. Here are {shown} of them.
at_second_approver: This is a big change, so a second person confirms it: the {role}.
at_stopped_paused: LynkAssist actions are paused. It still answers, but changes nothing.
at_stopped_role_off: The owner has switched this off for your role.
at_stopped_over_limit: This is over the limit the owner set.
at_stopped_content_not_instructions: This came from text LynkAssist read, so it is not done.
at_stopped_register: This needs a person or a quick check first.
at_pause_note: While paused, LynkAssist still answers but changes nothing.
at_roles_title: What LynkAssist may do for each role
at_roles_note: Never more than the role itself may do.
at_approver_amount: Ask a second person above this amount
at_approver_note: Also when a change touches more than {items} items. The person asking never confirms their own request.
at_memory_note: Kept for this business only. Never card numbers, PINs or codes. Never sold or shared.
at_never_secrets: Not kept: it looks like a card number or a code.
at_round_all: Round every price to a tidy amount
at_told_team: The team, on their next sale
at_practice_done: Done in practice. Nothing real changed.
at_sent_approver: Sent for a second person to confirm.
